result.reason: The added language gives Company a 30-day convenience right, but it does not expressly require a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. It also leaves the original bilateral 15-day termination right intact, permitting Vendor termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding rather than limiting Vendor to end-of-term termination on 90 days’ notice. The obligation to pay unspecified non-cancellable expenses is an unnecessary and potentially uncapped additional charge. Retaining overlapping termination provisions also creates ambiguity and weakens drafting quality.
